context: Undated: Living working journal (CONTEXT.md) for the HOMOS v2 project, a Uniswap v3 liquidity-provision research repo, with instructions for AI sessions to read it before work and append an entry after each session. Refers to PLAN.md for the full project plan.
2026-08-10: Decision to require backtesting before any deployment of a Uniswap v3 liquidity strategy. The validation gate: a strategy must beat HODL 50/50 across at least two market regimes.

2026-08-10: Decision to build no custom smart contract or vault; LP positions stay as NFTs in the owner's wallet, because $5–25k of capital does not justify the contract risk and cost. Relates to the HOMOS Uniswap v3 project's early architecture decisions.

2026-08-10: Journal decision record (Polish) on 10 August 2026 to rewrite the Uniswap v3 liquidity-provision core instead of repairing the legacy UI, because the math was wrong in every layer and a clean rewrite was cheaper.
2026-08-10: Journal decision to structure the HOMOS Uniswap v3 project as a TypeScript monorepo with core, data, backtest, bot and ui packages, so that one shared math module serves every layer.
2026-08-10: Journal decision to keep a SQLite database plus CSV ledger from the first transaction onward, justified by Polish tax reporting and auditability needs in the HOMOS Uniswap v3 LP project.

2026-08-11: Journal decision freezing ALGORITHM.md v1 for the HOMOS Uniswap v3 LP strategy: k=3 for ETH/stable (k=2 for cbBTC), 24 h hysteresis, payback ≤7 days, and a plain exit on a 5% break below the 7-day EMA as the trend breaker. Based on 365-day walk-forward and five out-of-sample cross-validation runs.

2026-08-11: Polish journal entry recording revision v1.1 of the ALGORITHM strategy rules: after a drop, re-entry is set to price back above the EMA for ETH/stable pools, while cbBTC keeps a plain exit. Justified by full 365-day runs that reversed an earlier ranking based on 90-day tests, with base-005 first passing the gate.

2026-08-18: Decision to withdraw the Windows auto-pull runner (git service and queue) and make code updates on Windows manual-only via `git pull`, because the queue had gone unused since 11 Aug and a periodic hard reset was a risk class behind the 17 Aug incident. The sole automated git action is the morning report push.

2026-08-17: Polish journal entry recording revision v1.2 of the HOMOS Uniswap v3 strategy, which switches the base-030 pool's trend breaker to a hedge-excess short on ETH perp above 50%, with exit as fallback until a perp venue is integrated. Rationale: the only configuration passing the gate on both windows, positive historical funding; full hedge and mainnet/005 hedging rejected.

2026-08-19: Journal decision to untrack the build artefact public/bundle.js (git rm --cached), keeping it only on disk. A tracked bundle had blocked the automated morning-report push on Windows after each build, failing three times that day.

Undated: Journal status summary for the HOMOS project covering 29 Aug, 18 Sep and 21 Sep 2026. It records the FlatWide LP closing at +$38 on 18 Sep, the remaining spot position, and the full sale to EUR on Kraken on 21 Sep for about +5.5%.

2026-08-19: Journal decision that after every pipeline fix the developer must manually verify the same day on Windows (running the pipeline fetch step and iterating until it passes), not rely on the 07:30 automated run. Rationale: the pipeline failed three days in a row on different causes, and one debug cycle per day was too slow.

2026-08-19: Journal decision to pin the `@envio-dev/hypersync-client` dependency to exactly 1.0.0 across the repo. Newer versions ship no Windows (win32) native binary, so the caret range broke on Windows while working on macOS. The API used is identical in 1.0.0.

2026-08-26: Journal decision from the weekly review on 26 Aug 2026: the volatility estimator moves to a 15-minute sampling grid and k is fully recalibrated on 365-day and 720-day data, because the swap-based σ measured pool microstructure rather than ETH.

2026-08-26: Decision to change the validation gate from a 365-day window to a 720-day window plus a recent ~90-day condition, after 365 days flattered the strategy and 0 of 21 configurations passed on 720 days. The recent condition keeps old turbulence from disqualifying a pool for years. (Uniswap v3 HOMOS backtesting.)

2026-08-26: Journal decision to keep the first tranche (6,092 USDC on Base) in USDC, with no Aave parking, until the recalibration and the "LP only in flat" experiment report. Reason: entering a narrow LP on a calibration declared broken, after 0 of 21 configurations passed the 720-day gate.

2026-08-26: Polish journal entry recording the 26 Aug 2026 review decisions: hUp48 kept paper-only, hysteresis unified as "time share in window" across three places, cbBTC k2/k3 and gas-USD backtest added to the batch, WETH-CBBTC 0.3% Base added to bot pools in paper mode, live gas in the observer.

2026-08-26: Decision in the HOMOS working journal setting operating hours: owner signatures 09:00–20:00 Mon–Fri, trend-breaker (EXIT_TREND) alarm running 24/7 including weekends, and measuring signature-delay cost from day one. Rationale: propose-only mode, delay is the only risk.

2026-09-02: Journal decision setting the exit rule for the first LP tranche: exit on 24 Sep regardless of price, or earlier once the tranche balance reaches +5%, with manual daily monitoring and no bot automation. Later revised on 16 Sep. Rationale: the product did not beat HODL in five measurements.

Undated: Polish-language journal status summary covering the tranche settlement question. The cockpit showed PnL from position anchors ($5,857) rather than the 6,092 USDC deposit, with the gap explained by a ~$150 WETH wallet buffer and ~$75 entry costs. Also records the 27–28 Aug FlatWide hybrid decision.

Records that this was the second rule change in one week, in the "hold" direction.

Rationale: sideways market, small stake, operational experiment value.

2026-09-21: Journal entry, in Polish, on the full sale of the first HOMOS tranche (Base Uniswap v3 LP, FlatWide) into EUR via Kraken on 21 Sep 2026 after a short-squeeze rally, closing at about +5.5% over 25 days. Covers the BTC/ETH price levels, the decision to sell by ~17:00, and the settlement calculation.
